fusions.name: Trailing Thread
fusions.desc: Looses a thread-trailing arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Anything struck moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Unravel
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Draped Hide
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 9 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Quilted Gambeson
fusions.desc: Conjures a padded coat: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 6%, your dodge chance rises by 4%, and 4% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
